newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's Chung Shing weighs Latvia plant.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Chung Shing weighs Latvia plant.

text.p: Taiwan's Chung Shing Textile Co said on Monday it was considering building a textile manufacturing plant in Latvia but declined to comment in detail.
"We are currently evaluating such a plan after our chairman (Chou Yin-hsi) recently visited Latvia to study the local market potential," a spokesman for Chung Shing said by telephone.
The spokesman declined to confirm a report in the Commercial Times newspaper that Chung Shing would invest US$23 million in the project.
"It is impossible to say how much we will invest at this point because the plan is still at a very preliminary stage," said the spokesman, who asked not to be named.
The company had set no timetable for the project, he said.
